name: A due date outside the period is rejected
title: SC-07-08-02 A due date outside the period is rejected
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site has units and period "2026-10" is not accrued
When the manager accrues period "2026-10" with due date "2026-12-15"
Then the request is rejected with status 400
And no liability and no period row is created
